question_text: During the campaign period for local elections, a barangay captain, Captain Santos, is asked by a candidate to allow a campaign rally in the barangay plaza. Captain Santos supports the candidate personally. Under RA 6713, what should Captain Santos do to demonstrate political neutrality?

options.text: Allow the rally because all candidates should have equal access to public facilities.
Deny the rally to avoid any appearance of partisan political activity.
Allow the rally but publicly state that he is not endorsing any candidate.
Refer the request to the barangay council for a collective decision.
